headline: Approved state school construction application and recommended seven Pawtucket High School construction contracts to Shawmut.
summary: The meeting gave an update on the Pawtucket High School building project, including steel work, a mockup wall, and a planned apprenticeship program presentation. Members approved a new state school construction application. They then recommended seven high school construction contracts to Shawmut Design & Construction, with all members voting yes.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the April 9, 2026 meeting, with all members voting yes.
Approved submitting a new Stage 1 Necessity of School Construction application to the RIDE School Building Authority, with all members voting yes.
Recommended awarding the Pawtucket High School scaffolding package to Shawmut Design & Construction, with all members voting yes.
Recommended awarding the Pawtucket High School roofing package to Shawmut Design & Construction, with all members voting yes.
Recommended awarding the Pawtucket High School drywall package to Shawmut Design & Construction, with all members voting yes.
Recommended awarding the Pawtucket High School fireproofing package to Shawmut Design & Construction, with all members voting yes.
Recommended awarding the Pawtucket High School doors, frames and hardware package to Shawmut Design & Construction, with all members voting yes.
Recommended awarding the Pawtucket High School food equipment and appliances package to Shawmut Design & Construction, with all members voting yes.
Recommended awarding the Pawtucket High School unit masonry package to Shawmut Design & Construction, with all members voting yes.
